## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior and scope. Link an issue if relevant.

## Validation

List exact commands/results and remaining limits. For gameplay compatibility,
identify anti-cheat version/configuration and client revision. For visuals,
attach rendered evidence at multiple scales and describe input checks.

- [ ] Relevant regressions passed on Java 8, or the remaining gate is documented.
- [ ] Runtime data, account information and secrets are excluded/redacted.
- [ ] New dependencies/assets have recorded provenance and required notices.

## Remaining gates

List pending launcher, native, game/server, visual or lifecycle checks. Keep this
PR as a draft while required acceptance is incomplete.
